purpose: Default current-design system signoff for the local RV64 dual-issue OoO core without requiring an Ubuntu 22.04 full-system run.

priority.reason: Close Linux, SBI, Sv39, interrupt, UART, process, timer and natural-poweroff semantics with bounded simulation cost.

L0_DIRECTED_RTL.scope: Module and transaction-contract testbenches for owner/holder, ready/valid, flush, replay, exception and memory-order behavior.
required_observations: affected directed tests pass
RTL assertions remain enabled and show zero failures
checker-changing work includes a compile-success expected-fail mutation

L1_FULL_CORE_DIFFTEST.scope: Current complete RV64 core, official/AM cohort and bounded benchmark guardrails.
required_observations: execution and publication are independently fail-closed
official and AM source logs bind byte-for-byte to the same run
semantic verifier rejects its frozen mutation inventory

L2_MINI_SYSTEM.scope: OpenSBI plus a purpose-built S/U supervisor payload on NpcSimTop.
required_observations: M-to-S-to-U transitions
Sv39 faults, permission recovery, A/D updates and sfence.vma remap
timer and PLIC/UART interrupts
AMO, LR/SC, fence, MMIO and natural syscon poweroff
duplicate terminal-event mutation is rejected
payload, OpenSBI, DTB and simulator source identities match before and after execution
post-binding, runtime cleanup and the final evidence-file seal all pass

L3_LIGHTWEIGHT_LINUX.scope: Linux 6.6 from the same source tree as the Ubuntu path, a minimal effective kernel config, libc-free static PID1/initramfs, OpenSBI and the production NpcSimTop device model.

case_policy.artifact_reuse: one Image/initramfs/effective-DTB/OpenSBI set; UART selector chooses the transaction after PID1

required_observations: Linux reaches PID1 with Sv39 and SBI SRST
devtmpfs, procfs, sysfs and tmpfs mount successfully
clone/wait4 and MAP_PRIVATE copy-on-write preserve the parent page
monotonic clock_nanosleep rejects invalid nsec and completes three valid rounds
tmpfs write, seek, read and unlink succeed
AMO and LR/SC execute in user mode
two UART RX bytes are each bracketed by ARM/RX phases and a UART-to-PLIC assertion in cycle/commit order
PASS precedes the UART-byte-stream kernel power-down, counted OpenSBI syscon poweroff, GOOD TRAP and clean system-reset exit exactly once
Linux source content, simulator source content, post-binding, cleanup and the final evidence-file seal all pass

optional_full_ubuntu.claim_when_run: optional Ubuntu 22.04/systemd recertification for its exact bound identity

identity_and_refresh.production_or_elaborated_rtl_semantics: rerun affected L0 plus L1, L2 and L3 according to scope
identity_and_refresh.privilege_mmu_interrupt_exception_memory: rerun affected L0 plus L1 plus L2 plus L3
identity_and_refresh.checker_parser_or_report_only: retain original execution state, recompute and match current RTL, simulator, layer-source and artifact identities, then produce a versioned frozen-input replay
identity_and_refresh.missing_raw_log_terminal_assertion_artif: execution cannot sign off and the affected layer must rerun
identity_and_refresh.ubuntu2204_full_recertification: never inferred from another trigger; explicit user request remains mandatory

task_run_keep: design, simulator, boot-artifact and tool identity
bounded console, terminal, assertion and phase extracts
final evidence manifest, verification log and seal receipt
runtime_keep: one validated current lightweight Linux artifact set
